values.note: City ordinance: non-resident camping fee $10 per night; electric and water hook-up $15 per 24 hours. The page doesn't say whether the hook-up fee replaces or adds to the camping fee.

fees.source: City of Madison, Madison City Lake Rules and Regulations - Camping (madisonkansas.org): '$10.00 per night or 24-hour period', 'The fee for electrical and water hook-up is $15.00 per 24-hour period'. Read 2026-11-06

values.note: Camping is limited to 7 days at a time without the mayor's permission (the fee rules cap a stay at 14 days).

note: City of Madison campground at the 114-acre city lake, 1 mile south and 1 mile west of town, kept by a city lake caretaker. Herringbone pull-through field with electric and water hookups on a rise above the lake; two shelter houses, swimming area, boat ramp, docks and a fish cleaning station. No dump station: haul tanks away. No alcohol, no glass. --Claude
